paragraphs.text: A chat box is not a finished product.
lined up TVs, phones, and cars: once the purpose is clear, the object gets out of the way. Software is not waiting decades. A few years after ChatGPT, the apps are already chats.
Four days earlier he wrote the other half. Chat falls apart when agents manage agents, so you need the plan, the diagram, and a before and after.
calls the usual window a log: the agent works where you cannot see it, and that gap is the product.
watched the new Siri and skipped the intelligence. The phone already holds the context. People still need to see where the assistant stops.
Start in the chat. Do not leave the work there.
